name: Bend and straighten the knees
short_description: Bend and straighten the knees once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can bend and straighten the knees in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Bend and straighten the knees means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Bend and straighten the knees in a fresh real-life scenario.
